Netzwerk and Netzwerk neu answer keys: A1–B1

Find the guide for your exact coursebook or workbook. The original Netzwerk edition has public publisher PDF links; Netzwerk neu solution entries currently require publisher registration. Choose the series before the level.

Original NetzwerkNetzwerk neu

Twelve book guides · Official publisher sources checked 15 November 2026

Which book do you have?

Kursbuch means coursebook. The original Netzwerk workbook is called Arbeitsbuch; Netzwerk neu calls it Übungsbuch. Searches such as “Netzwerk Übung neu” or “Arbeitsbuch neu” can mix these names, so read the cover and title page first.

A full A1, A2 or B1 volume and a combined .1/.2 half-volume can use different section layouts. Match the series, level, component, chapter range and exercise instruction. Compare your ISBN with the publisher catalogue; do not assume an answer fits because the chapter number is familiar.

What the resource links provide

A button marked “Open official PDF” points to a PDF endpoint on Klett’s website. A button marked “Find … on Klett” opens the official catalogue, where you select the level and resource and follow any account requirements. This directory does not host PDF copies, textbook scans or answer text.

The public availability of a file is separate from permission to republish it. Availability can also change. If a link fails, use the official series catalogue linked in the relevant book guide and look for the exact component and chapter range.

Use a key after an independent attempt

Finish a small task before opening its solution. Compare the instruction, identify the reason for a correction and retry a few mistakes later with the key closed. For open writing or speaking, models illustrate possibilities; they do not assess every valid response or certify a CEFR level.
